title: 才 vs 就 Step 2 · The 了 Rule: 就…了, 才 Without 了
description: 就 likes 了 at the end (他六点就来了), 才 never takes it (他十点才来 — not 才来了). Plus 才 vs 终于.

points.title: 就…了 vs 才 (no 了)
points.summary: In past sentences, 就 usually comes with 了; 才 does not.
points.body:
- ✔ 他六点**就**来**了**。
- ✔ 他十点**才**来。 — ~~他十点才来了~~
- Why? 才 already means 'only then' — the action happened late, not as a fresh completion.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢

points.title: 才 vs 终于
points.summary: 终于 = finally (relief, usually with 了); 才 = not until (stresses lateness).
points.body:
- 等了一个小时，车**终于**来**了**。 Finally the bus came. 😌
- 等了一个小时，车**才**来。 The bus didn't come until an hour later. 😤

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: After an hour the bus finally came.

notes: Word order and 了 are both off.
Word order and double 了 are wrong.
就 and 才 don't go together here.
questions.translation: She left as early as seven.
He didn't get home until midnight last night.

questions.prompt: The 了 rule: which sentences are correct? Select all of them.
questions.explanation: **就 … 了** but **才 without 了**.
notes: The 了 after 考 is fine; no 了 after 才通过.
才 … no 了: 九点才开始.
才 clashes with a final 了 — drop the 了.

questions.prompt: {等|děng}{了|le}{一个|yí ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}，{公共汽车|gōnggòng qìchē}（　）{来|lái}{了|le}，{太|tài}{好|hǎo}{了|le}！
notes: 才 doesn't take 了 — and stresses annoyance, not relief.
questions.translation: After an hour the bus finally came — great!

questions.prompt: 「{车|chē}{终于|zhōngyú}{来|lái}{了|le}。」 vs 「{车|chē}{一个|yí ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}{以后|yǐhòu}{才|cái}{来|lái}。」 — what's the difference in feeling?
options: Both mean the bus came early.
终于 means it didn't come.
终于 = relief (finally!); 才 = stresses it came late.
notes: 才 isn't happy — it stresses lateness.

questions.translation: I didn't go to bed until two last night.

questions.prompt: 'The film only started at nine.' Which sentence says so?
notes: 才 goes after the time word, and no 了.
就 = early — and needs 了.
questions.translation: The film didn't start until nine.

questions.explanation: After three tries, relief + 了 → **终于**.
notes: 就 = easily — but it took three tries.
questions.translation: I took it three times and finally passed!
He went to bed as soon as he got home.
